properties.displayName: [FedRAMP High] VMs for DNS: Diagnostic Settings Must Be Enabled
properties.description: Audits virtual machines that do not have diagnostic settings enabled for log forwarding. FedRAMP High requires audit generation (AU-12) and audit events (AU-2). DNS VMs must forward Windows Event Logs (Security, System, Application) and performance metrics to the centralized Log Analytics workspace via Azure Monitor Agent for security monitoring and incident response.

metadata.description: Audit: Report non-compliance for VMs without diagnostic settings. Disabled: Do not evaluate.
